```{r}
setwd("/home/data/Chenxi/workplace/scRNAseq/cross_species_scRNAseq/scripts_260424/scatlas_mutispecies_260426")
getwd()
suppressMessages(source("../coral_cs_functions/helper.R"))
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)
library(Biostrings)

fix_gene_name <- function(gene_names, prefix) {
    gene_names<-gsub("-","_", gene_names)
    ifelse(grepl(paste0("^", prefix), gene_names), gene_names, paste0(prefix, gene_names))
}
out_fn = "/home/data/Chenxi/workplace/scRNAseq/cross_species_scRNAseq/scripts_260424/260429_name_conversion"
sps_list = c("Adig","Ahya", "Amur", "Fspp", "Gfas", "Hcoe", "Pcru", "Pdam", "Plut", "Spis", "Xesp")
```

```{r}

for(spi in sps_list){
    message(sprintf("Processing species: %s", spi))
    if (spi == "Spis") {
        spi_w = "Spin"
	} else if (spi == "HcoeH" || spi == "HcoeI") {
        spi_w = "Hcoe"
    } else {
		spi_w = spi
	}
    #read seurat object and transform
    seu_fn = sprintf(
    "/home/data/Chenxi/workplace/scRNAseq/cross_species_scRNAseq/scripts_260424/scatlas_mutispecies_260426/results_metacell_%s_filt/dat.%s.seurat_final.rds",
    spi_w, spi_w)
    if (!file.exists(seu_fn)) {
        warning(sprintf("Seurat file not found: %s", seu_fn))
        next
    }
    message(sprintf("Reading Seurat object for species: %s", spi))
    seu <- readRDS(seu_fn)
    message(sprintf("Species %s: %d genes in seu", spi, nrow(seu@assays$RNA$counts)))
    gene = fix_gene_name(rownames(seu@assays$RNA$counts), paste0(spi, "_"))

    map_df <- data.frame(gene = gene, gene_seurat = rownames(seu@assays$RNA$counts))

    message(sprintf("Reading fasta for species: %s", spi))
    fasta_fn = sprintf("/home/data/Chenxi/workplace/scRNAseq/cross_species_scRNAseq/final_data/extended_protein_fasta_deduplicate_260426/%s_renamed_cleaned.longest.fasta", spi)
    prot_fasta = readAAStringSet(fasta_fn)
    desc <- names(prot_fasta)
    temp_name = str_remove(desc, paste0("^", spi, "_"))
    prot_df <- data.frame(protein_id = desc, transcript = str_remove(temp_name, "\\.p\\d+$"), gene = NA_character_)
    
    #read gtf and transform
    message(sprintf("Reading GTF for species: %s", spi))
    gtf_fn = sprintf("/home/data/Chenxi/workplace/scRNAseq/cross_species_scRNAseq/final_data/broccoli/reference_gtf/%s_long.annot.gtf",spi)
    if (!file.exists(gtf_fn)) {
    warning(sprintf("GTF file not found:  %s", gtf_fn))
    next
    }
    mapping <- rtracklayer::import(gtf_fn)
    transcript_to_gene <- dic_from_vecs(mapping$transcript_id, mapping$gene_id)
    prot_df$gene <- transcript_to_gene[prot_df$transcript]
    if (sum(is.na(prot_df$gene)) == nrow(prot_df)){
        prot_to_gene <- dic_from_vecs(mapping$protein_id, mapping$gene_id)
        prot_df$gene <- prot_to_gene[prot_df$protein_id]
    }
    prot_df$gene <- fix_gene_name(prot_df$gene, paste0(spi, "_"))
    message(sprintf("Species %s: %d total proteins", spi, nrow(prot_df)))
    message(sprintf("Species %s: %d genes unmapped", spi, sum(is.na(prot_df$gene))))

    final_df <- map_df %>%
        left_join(prot_df, by = c("gene" = "gene")) %>%
        dplyr::select(gene, gene_seurat, protein_id)
    message(sprintf("Species %s: %d genes mapped to protein", spi, sum(!is.na(final_df$protein_id))))

    write.table(
        final_df, 
        sprintf("%s/match.%s.protein.seu.csv", out_fn, spi), 
        sep = "\t", 
        col.names = TRUE, 
        row.names = FALSE, 
        quote = FALSE
    )
}
```
